name: Cainan
overview: The name Cainan, also spelled Kenan, appears in Genesis 5 as the son of Enos and the father of Mahalaleel. Scripture details Cainan's lifespan as 910 years, with 70 years before he fathered Mahalaleel and 840 years thereafter, highlighting the longevity common among early patriarchs. This genealogy situates Cainan within the line of Seth, emphasizing God's providential preservation of the godly lineage leading ultimately to Christ.
